status: proposed construction input; independent plan review required before builder use

axes.gltf: Blender exporter converts Z-up to glTF Y-up; builder must audit exported bounds rather than pre-swizzle vertices.

connectedTerraces.name: upper_cap
connectedTerraces.operation: inset connected host faces then offset outward/upward no more than 0.10m/0.06m; triangulate as faceted cap

connectedTerraces.name: front_bedding_ledge
connectedTerraces.operation: split the existing front-side quads and inset/extrude a 0.06–0.10m shallow continuous shelf; do not add a separate slab

connectedTerraces.name: erosion_gullies
connectedTerraces.operation: move selected existing side vertices inward 0.08–0.16m and split adjacent faces into planar facets; preserve closed shell
